definitions.explanation: A disaster caused by natural forces such as earthquakes, typhoons, floods, or droughts, as opposed to one caused by human action.

examples.japanese: {天災|てんさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
{天災|てんさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: I keep water ready in case of a natural disaster.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{天災|てんさい}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧⟦{人災|じんさい}→人災：29312_jinsai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: This damage is said to be a man-made disaster rather than a natural one.

notes:
Refers to a disaster brought about by nature rather than by human error.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {天災|てんさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to prepare for a natural disaster
- {天災|てんさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{遭|あ}う→遭う：09500_au⟧: to be struck by a natural disaster
- ⟦{思|おも}わぬ→思う：00492_omou⟧{天災|てんさい}: an unexpected disaster

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人災|じんさい}→人災：29312_jinsai⟧: man-made disaster — caused by human negligence or error
- ⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧: disaster — broader term covering both natural and man-made events
